sentences.text: This marine reptile belongs to the family Polycotylidae and is placed within the subfamily Polycotylinae.
Albright, Gillette, and Titus named the genus in 2007 after finding fossils in the Cenomanian-age Tropic Shale of Utah.
The type species of the genus is Eopolycotylus rankini, which was also described by Albright and colleagues in 2007.
It lived in the waters during the Cenomanian stage of the Cretaceous period, roughly between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago.
